idea: Evaluate a native Anthropic /v1/messages transport for Claude-via-Copilot to get faithful SIGNED chain-of-thought continuity (thinking + signature round-trip across the tool loop), versus the cheaper unsigned reasoning_text display+replay capture (sibling task codex-anthropic-chat-reasoning-text-capture-and-replay). Decide: now, fast-follow, or deferred.

candidateDirections.name: Probe-gated signed fast-follow (after unsigned ships)
candidateDirections.summary: Extend the existing Copilot-auth probe to /v1/messages to validate auth + signed thinking emission + signed replay; only if all three pass, build the overlay-first signed transport as a fast-follow after the unsigned capture, on a shared neutral reasoning-item scaffold.

candidateDirections.name: Build the native signed /v1/messages transport now (overlay-first, third WireApi arm)
candidateDirections.summary: Build the request builder + Messages-SSE parser (stop discarding the signature in anthropic_sse.rs) + a third WireApi/ModelWireRoute arm + wire_route_for/effective_wire_api/client.rs dispatch, in parallel with the unsigned sibling. Highest risk: unprobed endpoint, parallel-edit conflict on the two shared files, permanent third transport. Effort XL.

candidateDirections.name: Defer signed indefinitely; rely on unsigned reasoning_text
candidateDirections.summary: Accept the unsigned display+replay capture (the only verified Copilot behavior) as the continuity story; revisit signed only if a concrete observable need appears AND the probe proves signatures round-trip through the Copilot proxy.

questionsForSynthesis: What minimum probe result justifies the build: signed emission only, or full signed replay through a tool loop? (Synthesis answer: require BOTH.)

Can the unsigned sibling reserve a neutral persisted-reasoning item shape that later carries signature metadata, so the signed fast-follow extends it rather than re-editing anthropic_sse.rs + payload.rs?
Does Copilot preserve, rewrite, or reject Anthropic signatures when proxying /v1/messages?
Should signed Messages get a stricter sub-flag vs. reusing CODEX_ENABLE_ANTHROPIC until validated?
